It is designed to be invariant under model interpretation and relies solely on syntactic structure. The validation heuristic uses import detection as a proxy for presence of input sanitization logic, which is a strong but imperfect signal. Failure modes include incomplete parsing of certain files and false negatives in validation detection due to indirect or external validation mechanisms.
